label: KDIC mistaken-transfer support — maximum per transfer
appliesTo: One mistaken transfer. The floor on the same programme is ₩50,000, and the programme restricts applications covering only part of a single claim — a larger transfer cannot be split to fit under the ceiling.
why: This ceiling has moved twice, and English-language guidance lags it badly: pages still circulate quoting ₩10,000,000 and ₩50,000,000 as the limit. A reader who believes an outdated figure concludes they are ineligible and never applies.

history.source: Easy Law (Ministry of Government Legislation) — mistaken transfer return support
history.note: Recorded at the date this site first verified it, not the date it changed. Earlier stages of the programme carried lower ceilings.
